== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[Dash In Rogue 12 (Errata)|Dash In Rogue 12]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column; a change of the printed errata mark alone is its own column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table (Bill, 2026-11-17; dest miss #599)|SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
